prerequisite_failure_rule: Each failed gate stops before the next prerequisite: gates 1-3 stop before any dependent canary, gate 4 stops before the semantic pilot, and any pilot qualification stopper stops before the fleet.
authorization_binding_rule: At gate 1 the immutable authorization receipt binds authorized_matrix_ref and authorized_matrix_sha256; authorization_receipt_ref and authorization_receipt_sha256 bind the receipt bytes. All four non-null values must match charter/pilot_plan.v4.json and the final freeze receipt exactly.
final_freeze_required_membership: The input path set equals charter/pilot_plan.v4.json final_freeze_contract.required_static_refs, which includes the pilot plan itself, plus exactly the resolved non-null gate-1 authorized matrix and immutable authorization receipt. Matrix/receipt refs and hashes match the receipt, pilot plan, matrix status, and freeze receipt; every byte/hash/digest check passes.
gate_4_pass_requirement: All ten exact routes preserve requested reasoning/variant settings, pass provider/model/account/route binding, and pass every route-declared required or exposed effective reasoning/variant attestation under the same final freeze and deterministic receipt.
release_condition: Jared supplies and authorizes the exact eight-relative-low routes pairwise distinct by underlying model within the low stratum and two relative-high routes pairwise distinct within the high stratum, including each exact provider/model/account/route tuple and requested reasoning/variant settings. Ten distinct overall is preferred; any cross-stratum overlap must be explicitly selected by Jared and disclosed. No replacement, overlap, or split change is implicit.
